metadata.title: Terms of Service
metadata.description: Terms and conditions for using the service

overview.title: 1. Service Overview
overview.content: {siteName} ("the Service") is a platform for sharing skills, agents, and guides for AI coding tools. It provides skill search, viewing, and deployment via MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.

conditions.title: 2. Usage Conditions
items: Google OAuth authentication is required to use the Service.
Content you post (skills, agents, guides, etc.) must be authored by you or content you have rights to distribute.
You must not distribute content that intentionally contains malicious code or security vulnerabilities.
You must not use data collected through the Service for unauthorized commercial purposes.

rights.title: 3. Content Rights
rights.content: Intellectual property rights of content posted by users belong to the original author. By posting content to the Service, you grant other users a non-exclusive license to search, view, and install that content within the Service.

disclaimer.title: 4. Disclaimer
items: The Service is provided "as is" with no warranty of availability or accuracy.
The Service operator is not liable for damages caused by skills/agents installed by users.
The Service may change or discontinue features without prior notice.

account.title: 5. Account & Access
account.content: The Service operator may restrict access or deactivate accounts of users who violate these terms. Organization administrators may manage access rights for their members.

changes.title: 6. Changes to Terms
changes.content: These terms may be changed with prior notice. Updated terms take effect from the time they are posted to the Service. Important changes will be announced via in-service notice or email.
